project: The Economics of Getting to Work
status: Blank research instrument and model specification; no observed survey results or location-specific facts are bundled.
pii_policy: Do not collect names, exact home locations, phone numbers, email addresses, employer IDs, or raw GPS coordinates. Use opaque case identifiers. Obtain participant consent and a retention/deletion plan for any field survey.
unit: INR, minutes and workdays per month
fields: Opaque record code, no personal identity
A or B comparison label; not necessarily treatment/control
Total daily commute expense, both ways
Door-to-door travel minutes per day, both ways
Additional planned daily time for unreliable travel
Monthly work-related childcare or care cost
Researcher or respondent-assumed value of time per hour
outputs: cash_remaining_inr_month = take_home_wage_inr - housing_inr_month - commute_cash_inr_day * workdays_month - care_inr_month
caveats: Cash remaining excludes food, utilities, health, taxes outside take-home pay and other expenditures.
Value of time is a user assumption, not an observed welfare parameter unless estimated independently.
Comparing observed wage groups is not a causal effect of transit or housing without credible identification.
A blank field template contains no actual data and must not be presented as a representative sample.
